name: tanpo-ops
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from LiquidAI/LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 128000). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-31. A domain SFT (LoRA r=16, merged via PEFT merge_and_unload into full weights in this repo) of LiquidAI/LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct, identical tensor set, sixth sibling alongside tanpo-deals/finance/fundraising/hiring/marketing/product. Recorded because the card prints a base row and a this-model row in the same table: DarkLab ops rubric 90.7% vs 89.5%. Same caveat as its siblings and it matters here: the margin is only +1.2 points on the author's own ~20-task automated rubric, the card calls it directional and not an industry benchmark, and it admits the model TRAILS the base on handoffs (-7.4), sops, operating_cadence and incident_postmortem (~-3.7 each). The +17.1 identity gain is what carries the mean. Not Apache-2.0: LFM Open License v1.0, ~$10M revenue threshold. Repo created 2026-09-18. Confidence 0.45.

benchmarks.name: DarkLab ops rubric, overall
benchmarks.config: Card 'Evaluation' table '| Model | Rubric overall |': row 'Base LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct' 89.5% vs row 'tanpo-ops' 90.7%. Same prompts and generation config for both. Author's own DarkLab automated rubric, self-described as directional not an industry benchmark, sample size small. Category deltas only (no absolute scores printed): +17.1 identity, +11.1 okr_execution, +5.5 capacity_planning, +5.6 vendor_ops; LOSES -7.4 handoffs and ~-3.7 each on sops, operating_cadence, incident_postmortem.
